headline: Bitcoin is holding near $75,800 after Friday's 11-week low, US bitcoin funds have now lost money on net for 2026, and MEXC says it is operating normally after the US Treasury's cut-off order.

market.asOf: From CoinGecko at about 03:55 UTC Sat 7 Nov (10:55 Bangkok). Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: Fear: alternative.me's Crypto Fear & Greed Index read 28 (Fear); CoinMarketCap's own index read 31. Both read about 03:55 UTC Sat 7 Nov.

stories.title: Bitcoin holds near $75,800 after an 11-week low, and bitcoin funds turn negative for 2026
stories.summary: A much stronger than expected US jobs report raised the odds that the Fed raises interest rates in December, and bitcoin briefly fell below $75,000 on Friday. It has been roughly flat since. Money flowing out of US spot bitcoin funds this week has wiped out all of their net inflows for the year.
points: Bitcoin was $75,836 on CoinGecko at about 03:55 UTC Saturday, with a 24h range of $74,921 to $76,280.
Friday's low was $74,762 per Cointelegraph, or $74,780.91 per Decrypt, the weakest since 21 August.
US payrolls rose 165,000 in October against a 65,000 forecast and unemployment fell to 4.1%, per CoinDesk.
Odds of a December rate hike were 76.8% on CME FedWatch per Cointelegraph, and 77% per CoinDesk, after the data.
US spot bitcoin funds are down about $502M on net for 2026 per SoSoValue data via KuCoin, or about $510M per Cointelegraph.

stories.title: MEXC says it is operating normally after the US Treasury order, and a partner pulls out
stories.summary: The US Treasury's FinCEN ordered US financial institutions to stop processing funds transfers to or from crypto exchange MEXC once the order takes effect. MEXC says user assets are safe and it has started an independent review of its controls. On-chain fund platform Reserve said it will stop providing liquidity for two tokens, LCAP and CMC20, on MEXC.
points: FinCEN alleges at least $16B of illicit-linked flows through MEXC between May 2021 and May 2026, including about $1.5B tied to Russian sanctions evasion, per Decrypt.
The order takes effect 30 days after it is published in the Federal Register, per Decrypt.
MEXC says it is reviewing the order with its legal and compliance teams and plans to talk with FinCEN, per TechFlow.
Reserve is halting liquidity for its LCAP and CMC20 tokens on MEXC and withdrawing committed funds, per ChainCatcher.

stories.title: Binance hack: $3.1B still in hacker wallets as Binance plans to reopen withdrawals
stories.summary: Blockchain analysts at Elliptic say the hackers behind the Binance theft are slowly converting stolen coins into bitcoin, but only a negligible amount has likely been cashed out. Binance says it has replaced virtually all stolen assets and plans to reopen more withdrawals by the end of next week.
points: About $3.11B sits in addresses linked to the theft, $2.85B is frozen and $470M is unaccounted for, per The Block citing Elliptic.
About $124M of stolen tokens has been swapped into bitcoin, across more than 20,000 wallets on 16 blockchains, per The Block.
The Block puts the total breach at $6.43B, citing Elliptic.
Binance aims to reopen HYPE, INJ, APT, PLASMA, NEAR and LTC withdrawals by the end of next week, per The Block.

briefs.title: Bitcoin ETFs: Friday flows not out yet
briefs.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs lost about $430M on Thursday; BlackRock's IBIT had $105M of outflows, its fifth straight day, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: Russia opens retail crypto trading on 17 Nov
briefs.summary: Only BTC, ETH and USDT, and ordinary investors are capped at 300,000 rubles a year per intermediary and must pass a test, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: US sanctions 45 more Prince Group targets
briefs.summary: OFAC added 4 people and 41 entities tied to the Cambodian scam group, per Decrypt.

briefs.title: Treasury drops $250 crypto Travel Rule plan
briefs.summary: FinCEN and the Fed withdrew a 2020 proposal to lower the threshold for collecting transfer data from $3,000 to $250, per The Block.

briefs.title: Crypto-in-401(k) rule moves to White House review
briefs.summary: The Labor Department sent a proposed rule on alternative assets, including crypto, in 401(k) plans to the White House for review, per The Block.

briefs.title: Greece passes a crypto tax
briefs.summary: A 10% tax on gains above 500 euros a year and 15% on staking and DeFi income, from 1 January 2027, per Decrypt.

briefs.title: Gnosis Pay discloses a data breach
briefs.summary: Unauthorized access to its old debit-card system was detected on 3 Nov and some customer data was exposed; the company says funds were not affected, per The Block.

briefs.title: Zcash's NU7 upgrade goes live
briefs.summary: Block time drops from 75 to 25 seconds, and about 12,224 ZEC left in the old Sprout pool can no longer be spent, per The Block.
